# Edwin Plange

> Founder and product engineer in Accra, Ghana. I build AI-powered products, agent workflows, and software that connects model reasoning to real business operations.

Website: https://edwinplange.vercel.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/JayPlange

## Projects

### KasaFlow
WhatsApp AI ordering operator for a jewellery retailer. Connects WhatsApp Cloud API, OpenAI, WooCommerce, and Google Geocoding. Uses controlled tool execution, deterministic checks, and explicit confirmation before order creation.
https://edwinplange.vercel.app/

### The Last Yes
A benchmark for testing transaction-authorisation integrity in tool-using conversational agents. Uses a Python simulator and deterministic grading to test consent, authority, and execution boundaries.
https://github.com/JayPlange

### DualProfile
A Chrome extension for scheduled WhatsApp profile photos and per-contact photo sharing.
https://github.com/JayPlange/DualProfile

### Stall to Store
A prototype that turns short product videos and spoken descriptions into structured, reviewable product listings using Meta AI tools.
https://edwinplange.vercel.app/

### Webblabs
Multi-branch operations dashboard for microfinance workflows, with frontend engineering, workflow discovery, and extensive automated testing.
https://edwinplange.vercel.app/

## Areas of Work

- Applied AI and agentic workflows
- API integrations and automation
- Product engineering
- Conversational commerce
- Transaction safety and tool-use evaluation
- Frontend engineering and testing

## Background

I have worked in product development, IT compliance, and network operations. My approach is to understand real workflows, build working systems, and test how they behave under failure and uncertainty.
